# Marble Skill Taxonomy Attribution

Movo Learn bundles data from the open-source **Marble Skill Taxonomy**:

- Upstream: https://github.com/withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy
- License: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) — see `LICENSE` in this folder
- Bundled files: `topics.json`, `dependencies.json`, `clusters.json`, `curriculum-standards.json`, `manifest.json`

Marble is used as a curriculum map (skills, evidence criteria, and prerequisites). Movo Learn lesson stories, questions, and activities are original application content and are stored separately from child progress data.

Child profile and learning progress are private local user data and are never written into Marble curriculum files.
